items.title: Beta 0.6.0 — liquid, chats, music
items.body: The island opens like liquid glass and comes in five shapes. Chats (ChatGPT, Claude, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord…) open right inside it. A new Music tab with its own volume, a Time tab, Calendar, a Notes board, a file shelf and notifications from your PC.

items.title: Drop files on the island
items.body: Drag files onto the island: drop on the left to keep them on the shelf, on the right to copy them to the Desktop.

items.title: Meet the new Cloudy
items.body: Cloudy is now a soft 3D cloud, puts on headphones when music plays, talks about what's on your screen and has his own room. Put him on your desktop from his room.
